tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Run a KQL query on a Log Analytics workspace over a time range, for example AppRequests | where Success == false | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Name. Returns each table's columns and rows, at most 500 rows, and a link to the workspace's logs.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

query.description: The KQL query, passed to Log Analytics as given. Use take or summarize to keep the result small.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: one hour before until.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

workspace.description: The workspace name or ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one workspace.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List what changed in a subscription in a time range, newest first, from its Activity Log: deployments, writes, deletes and actions on resources, with who made them and whether they failed.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

resource.description: Only changes to this resource. Its full resource ID, for example /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/shop/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/checkout.

resourceGroup.description: Only changes in this resource group.

since.description: Only changes at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

subscription.description: The subscription ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one subscription.

until.description: Only changes before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.
